scene: Living room by bookshelf in afternoon. Buddy stands on all four paws almost nose-to-small OLD SMART SPEAKER on lowest shelf, petitioning it with open but natural speaking-dog mouth and eager upward gaze. Small GREEN LIGHT RING on speaker only, no face, no hologram or robot body, no text. Neet sits a little behind him with reserved knowing sideways look, watching Buddy try to order absurd quantities of tennis balls. Exactly ONE oversized chartreuse tennisball rests in a nearby basket, not hundreds and not a floating thought bubble. Books/couch/background stringlights through window. Comedy is earnest appetite versus a tiny helpful boundary. Fully owned limbs, normal mouths, warm paper monochrome drawn rough. Smooth clean body tones; no hair hatching on torso or legs.
placement_after: Buddy deflated. “One. But put ‘emotionally significant’ in the notes.”
